description: Source code for SBC codec implementation, including configuration, encoding, decoding, and QoS management within Bluetooth A2DP profile.

classes.name: SBC
classes.description: Implementation of SBC codec for Bluetooth A2DP, handling configuration, encoding, decoding, and quality adjustments.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures SBC codec with stream format and settings.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves current SBC configuration as stream format and settings.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes supported or actual SBC capabilities into a stream.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes raw PCM frames into SBC frames.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes SBC frames into raw PCM frames.

methods.name: QOS
methods.description: Adjusts the quality of SBC encoding by changing the bitpool.
